content: He who sees all beings in the Self, and the Self in all beings, can never harbor hatred for anyone.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Yastu sarvani bhutani atmanyevanupashyati (यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतानि आत्मन्येवानुपश्यति) — Isha Upanishad 6
explanation: Hatred requires a fundamental hallucination of separateness: believing that the other person is fundamentally alien to yourself. When the eye of inner wisdom opens, you recognize the identical pulse of consciousness shining through every pair of eyes. How can the left hand hate the right?
practicalInsight: When someone irritates or attacks you today, gaze beneath their behavior and recognize the same vulnerable spirit living within them.
reflectionPrompt: Who are you currently viewing as an 'alien enemy', and what would happen if you saw your own reflection in their eyes?
